title: Visual builder theme tokens and section backgrounds

entries.summary: Design colors can be theme tokens (accent, text, surface, …) compiled to var(--pub-…). Section/row/column background image plus overlay in the live stylesheet.
No schema change. Tokens and bg_media_id live in layout_json; image files stay in uploads. Compiled CSS is still derived at render.
cms-builder-drag-column-size clicks Accent on the section and asserts var(--pub-accent) in editor and public stylesheets.
